Source: AMD Announces New $6 Billion Share Repurchase Authorization. Published date: 2025-05-14. URL: https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1251/amd-announces-new-6-billion-share-repurchase-authorization.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: SANTA CLARA, Calif., May 14, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) today announced that its board of directors approved a new $6 billion share repurchase program. The new authorization is in addition to the remaining balance, as of March 29, 2025, of approximately $4 billion of its existing share repurchase program, increasing the total current repurchase authority to approximately $10 billion. “Our expanded share repurchase program reflects the Board’s confidence in AMD’s strategic direction, growth prospects, and ability to consistently generate strong free cash flow,” said AMD Chair and CEO Dr. Lisa Su. The timing and total amount of stock repurchases will depend upon market conditions and may be made from time to time in open market purchases or privately negotiated purchases. Billions of people, leading Fortune 500 businesses and cutting-edge scientific research institutions around the world rely on AMD technology daily to improve how they live, work and play.
